name: Tofu (Silken)
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as it's low FODMAP and easily digestible. Choose organic varieties when possible.
preparationTips: Drain gently as silken tofu is very delicate
Perfect for smoothies, desserts, and creamy sauces
Can be blended into salad dressings for protein boost
Store opened packages in water in refrigerator for up to 3 days
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Good source of calcium and iron
Contains isoflavones with potential health benefits
Low in saturated fat and cholesterol-free
